claims.proposition: Deleting 80–90% of installed skills improves agent performance.
claims.assessment: The source provides advice, not a controlled causal comparison across harnesses.
claims.limits: Deletion percentage cannot be treated as a validated target.
claims.temporalScope: November 9, 2026 creator video; source paraphrases checked against machine ASR, not independently listening-certified.

claims.proposition: Visible skill metadata can consume context or discovery budget.
claims.assessment: Anthropic documents always-visible discovery metadata with on-demand instructions. OpenAI documents a bounded Codex initial skill list with progressive disclosure and possible truncation or omission. These vendor-specific mechanisms support the distinction between metadata and full bodies; they do not quantify performance gains from deleting skills.
claims.limits: Vendor specifications are implementation-specific and mutable. Neither source establishes universal prompt overhead or a controlled deletion-versus-accuracy effect.
claims.temporalScope: November 9, 2026 creator video; source paraphrases checked against machine ASR, not independently listening-certified.

claims.proposition: Overlapping descriptions may cause inappropriate skill selection.
claims.assessment: A plausible selection mechanism, not a measured failure rate.
claims.limits: A controlled harness-specific evaluation is still needed.
claims.temporalScope: November 9, 2026 creator video; source paraphrases checked against machine ASR, not independently listening-certified.

claims.proposition: Infrequently used skills should be removed.
claims.assessment: Frequency does not account for business criticality or rare incident-response obligations.
claims.limits: Critical low-use procedures require separate preservation criteria.
claims.temporalScope: November 9, 2026 creator video; source paraphrases checked against machine ASR, not independently listening-certified.

claims.proposition: Repeated workflows may benefit from reusable specialized skills.
claims.assessment: Reuse may improve consistency but does not itself confer privilege or correctness.
claims.limits: Separate authorization, provenance and operational testing remain necessary.
claims.temporalScope: November 9, 2026 creator video; source paraphrases checked against machine ASR, not independently listening-certified.

claims.proposition: Globally exposed skills can add irrelevant discovery overhead.
claims.assessment: Potential overhead depends on each harness discovery and retrieval design.
claims.temporalScope: November 9, 2026 creator video; source paraphrases checked against machine ASR, not independently listening-certified.

proposedReaderRelationships.reason: Source-custody and result-inspectability companion, not corroboration of deletion claims.
Agent invocation and operational permissions need a boundary independent of instruction files.
Retrieval, recall and pruning interact; least-used does not mean least valuable.
